params.query: D2C revenue by customer loyalty tier

params.content: D2C revenue by loyalty tier: use d2c_orders.revenue_inr (sum line_total, excl. soft-deleted) grouped by dim_customer.loyalty_tier via the SL join d2c_orders.customer_email = dim_customer.email. Validated for Aug 2026: the sum across tiers (26,795,722.38 INR) equals the unsplit D2C total exactly, so every order matched a customer and the join doesn't duplicate rows. Tiers observed: BRONZE, SILVER, GOLD, PLATINUM (uppercase). loyalty_tier is the customer's CURRENT tier, not the tier held when the order was placed. Source: analysis turn answering "D2C revenue by loyalty tier, August 2026".
